entity.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)

lineage.description: IOM DTM conducted sample surveys across displacement sites in two rounds to assess population presence, living conditions, and needs among internally displaced persons from the Fuego volcano eruption in Guatemala. The survey data captures post-event displacement impacts and humanitarian conditions at specific sites.
